settingIncludeTitleTitle: Show the post title at the top of the body

emptyScan: No scan results yet. Select a publishing notebook and click Scan.
categorySelectTitle: Changes are saved to the SiYuan custom-blog-category attribute immediately

bulkCategorySaveFailed: Saved the category for {saved}/{total} documents; the rest failed: {error}
selectNotebookFirst: Select a publishing notebook in plugin settings first.
scanningDocuments: Scanning documents and preparing Markdown previews…
bridgeUnavailableHint: ; local sync status is unavailable, but preview still works. Hover here for details

bulkCategoryTitle: Set a category for selected posts
applyCategoryTitle: The category is saved to the SiYuan document attribute immediately
settingWindowsPathDescription: Enter the root of the blog project on Windows. The Bridge selects this path automatically when it runs on Windows.
settingMacPathDescription: Enter the root of the blog project on macOS. The Bridge selects this path automatically when it runs on macOS.
